adaptation.basis: New architectural working design derived from actual reference roles and framing relationships; original size is not a constraint.
adaptation.section_policy: Exact recorded sections, no ripping or planing. Three post families paired; beams/ties 50.8x203.2, rafters 38.1x139.7, rails/webs/braces 38.1x88.9 mm.
changes: Six posts retained; lengthwise support bays reduced to 2400 mm.
Seven repeated gable trusses at 800 mm pitch; 2400 mm transverse axis span and 800 mm rise.
Paired truss layer offset 44.45 mm recorded; five roof rails subdivided at trusses.
Twelve visible knee braces retained and four visible end-bay roof-plane diagonals added and allocated.

profile.notes: Original jointing-pattern workflow enabled, but this working option uses one continuous stock segment per member; butt joints only at declared supported beam/rail subdivisions. No verified splice capacity.

roof_covering.load_allowance: Non-timber covering allowance considered in preliminary analysis only; covering/fasteners/foundation remain separate procurement items.

geometry.contact_semantics: Assembly connection envelopes represent explicit prospective joints; touching/overlapping solids are not verified mechanical connections.

allocation.optimality_scope: Optimal within saved bounded cutting-pattern menu; not proof over unrestricted fabrication patterns.

assumptions.connection_model: In-plane hinge with lateral cleat; two out-of-plane rotations restrained locally by ideal connector; NOT all joints rigid.

warnings: Preliminary elastic study, not strength/furniture/building-code or construction approval.
Anchored pinned bases, in-plane hinges and conceptual out-of-plane lateral cleats; fastener, anchor, plate and joint capacities unverified.
Roof cover 0.25 kPa, snow sensitivity 1.2 kPa and 卤wind/uplift 0.5 kPa are explicit study assumptions; not site-verified loads.
Connection offsets use massless finite rigid arms at factor 1000; no ground stabilization springs.

kinematics.method: Independent zero-strain rigid-member constraints: shared point translations plus two orthogonal relative rotations per explicit in-plane hinge; six base translations. No stiffness tuning or numerical result reuse.

analysis.deformation_display: User-selected magnification, numerical displacement values unscaled.

unresolved: Fasteners, joint/notch details, plates and foundation anchors are conceptual; their capacity and additional joinery losses have not been verified.
Roof cover and foundation construction are separate procurement/design items.
Recorded seller dimensions and nominal quantities are not current measured or guaranteed availability.
Site-specific loads, design code and serviceability/strength acceptance remain unverified; wind results are a sensitivity study.
